title: Read-only web/mobile catalog comparison preserves offer IDs and separates listing from purchase verification
summary: Implemented a local Node dashboard comparison of observed web/mobile prepaid roots, nested returned categories, and general/subscriber-available offer lists. Reports preserve category IDs separately from offerId/relatedOfferId pairs, count mobile-only and general-only discoveries, and name-match Long Expiry. Fixed pagination to recognize pageInfo.total and prevented distinct offerId values sharing a relatedOfferId from collapsing during research. The research route requires a current existing session, does not silently log in, accepts no upstream-path overrides, skips unsupported personalized flows with explicit warnings, and limits requests to 80. All 39 mocked tests passed, including an HTTP test that injects a purchase path and confirms only catalog queries occur. The running local route was also checked without credentials and returned HTTP 401. No live signed-in account catalog, eligibility, purchase, or fulfillment was verified; owner sign-in and comparison results remain necessary.
nextSteps: Owner signs in to the running private dashboard and selects Compare catalogs and offer IDs; inspect sanitized catalog results for exact Long Expiry matches and additional subscriber-listed offers.
Treat subscriber listing as discovery evidence only. Explicit promo/price/recipient selection remains necessary before any purchase test.
